Tooltip_OMHTT_BedSpikes: Crafts two independent spike tiles. Place two together, or one remaining tile alone. Each fall wears only the landing tile. Walk safely; running risks scratches and sprinting risks a fall. Free ten-second repair; five-second pickup per tile.
Tooltip_OMHTT_PortableBarrier: Right-click the crafted item and choose Place Trap. Placement consumes one finished barrier and grants no XP.
Tooltip_OMHTT_BarrierPack: Contains five Spike Barriers. Unpack in the Crafting menu. Bundled encumbrance is reduced by 67 percent.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ReinforcedBarrier: Right-click the crafted item and choose Place Trap.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ReinforcedPack: Five reinforced barriers. 67 percent less weight.
Tooltip_OMHTT_TurretBase: Holds a head, ammo, modules and a battery.
Tooltip_OMHTT_PotatoHead: Install in a turret base. Uses potatoes and power.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleStorage: Storage prototype. Module effects are not enabled yet.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleFiring: Fires on signal. Add Detection for automatic fire.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleMotionDetection: Tracks zombies. Add Firing to shoot automatically.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ModuleVelocity: Increases damage and knockdown chance. Stackable.
Tooltip_OMHTT_Barbs: Attach to a wall, fence, door or window. Door barbs follow the leaf; window barbs stay on the frame. Slows and damages zombies touching the exposed side. Walk safely; running risks scratches and sprinting risks a fall.
Tooltip_OMHTT_MotionDetectionImprovised: Automatic detection at 75 percent range, including Range bonuses. Normal tracking speed. One Detection Module per turret.
Tooltip_OMHTT_FiringImprovised: Automatic firing with a configurable 15 percent default click-only failure. Failed triggers keep ammo and shot power, then wait the normal cooldown. Manual fire is unaffected. One Firing Module per turret.
Tooltip_OMHTT_CapacityImprovised: Adds 2 module slots and 25 reserve rounds by default. Replaces other expansion kits; bonuses do not stack.
Tooltip_OMHTT_ConcertinaWire: Linked 1x2 freestanding wire. Slows and damages zombies during contact; overlapping wire and panels do not stack. 50 shared durability, one wear per damaging activation. Walk safely; running risks scratches and sprinting risks a fall.
